newsitem.title: UK: Celltech sees drug launches in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Celltech sees drug launches in 1998.

text.p: Biotechnology firm Celltech Group Plc said on Tuesday that its two most advanced products will achieve international registration and launch in 1998.

The company, which reported a full-year 3.0 million stg profit after a previous 5.4 million loss, said a pivotal study in 1900 septic shock patients to test the anti-TNF antibody BAYX-1351, developed with Bayer, is nearing completion.
A further Phase III study should begin in 1997 with the novel human anti-TNF antibody BAY-3356 as a second generation product for septic shock.

"Celltech is now well advanced in its evolution into a self- sustaining and profitable research-based pharmaceutical company, with major progress having been achieved during 1996," Celltech said in a statement.
The 1996 result was inflated by a 12.2 exceptional gain on the disposal of the Biologics manufacturing business earlier in the year.
